text.hi: किताब का आख़िरी सवाल: दोस्त को संदेश लिखो कि तुम उसकी जन्मदिन पार्टी में नहीं आ सकते क्योंकि दादी के घर जा रहे हो। ऐसे लिखो: Dear Rohan, I am sorry I cannot come to your birthday party, as I am going to my grandma's home. Happy birthday! Have fun. Your friend, Amit.
text.hinglish: Kitaab ka aakhiri sawaal: dost ko sandesh likho ki tum uski janmdin party mein nahi aa sakte kyonki daadi ke ghar ja rahe ho. Aise likho: Dear Rohan, I am sorry I cannot come to your birthday party, as I am going to my grandma's home. Happy birthday! Have fun. Your friend, Amit.
text.en: The paper's last question: write a message to your friend that you cannot come to the birthday party because you are going to your grandma's home. Write: Dear Rohan, I am sorry I cannot come to your birthday party, as I am going to my grandma's home. Happy birthday! Have fun. Your friend, Amit.
